ghe-copilot.name: GitHub Enterprise Copilot
ghe-copilot.authHint: Enter your GHE instance URL (e.g., https://ghe.company.com) in provider settings, then authenticate via device flow.

xai-oauth.name: xAI OAuth (Grok)
xai-oauth.authHint: Sign in with xAI to use api.x.ai models such as Grok 4.5. This is separate from Grok Build JWT sessions, which use cli-chat-proxy.grok.com and grok-build model aliases.

openference.name: Openference
openference.authHint: Sign in with your Openference account to route requests through api.openference.com. An active plan is required for inference — OAuth may authenticate but return 402 without one.

grok-cli.name: Grok Build
grok-cli.authHint: Sign in with your browser, or paste your ~/.grok/auth.json (or the JWT access token) from the Grok Build CLI; refresh_token is rotated automatically either way.

agy.name: Antigravity CLI
agy.authHint: Import your Antigravity CLI (`agy`) login (paste/upload its token file), auto-detect a local CLI login, or sign in with Google. Shares the Antigravity backend (incl. Claude models).

amazon-q.name: Amazon Q
amazon-q.authHint: Uses the same AWS Builder ID or imported refresh-token flow as Kiro, but keeps Amazon Q connections separate.

zed.name: Zed IDE
zed.authHint: Zed stores LLM provider credentials (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, xAI) in the OS keychain. Use the Import button below to discover and import them automatically.

zed-hosted.name: Zed Hosted Models
zed-hosted.authHint: Sign in with your Zed account (native-app sign-in). OmniRoute generates a one-time RSA keypair and opens zed.dev to authorize it — on a remote/headless install, copy the resulting 127.0.0.1 callback URL from your browser

trae.name: Trae
trae.authHint: Trae is an AI-native IDE by ByteDance (SOLO remote agent). Authorize via trae.ai in the popup, or sign in at solo.trae.ai and paste the Cloud-IDE-JWT (sent as

raycast.name: Raycast Pro AI
raycast.authHint: Unofficial integration — uses your Raycast Pro subscription via credentials from the macOS app (Auto-Import or manual capture). May break on Raycast updates. Not for redistribution; personal use only.

kimi-coding.name: Kimi Code CLI
kimi-coding.authHint: Sign in with the same Kimi account used by Kimi Code CLI. OmniRoute uses the CLI OAuth flow and Kimi Coding Plan endpoints.

devin-desktop.name: Devin Desktop
devin-desktop.authHint: Paste an existing Devin API key from an authenticated Devin session. Key export availability and steps vary by Devin version and account.

devin-cli.name: Devin CLI
devin-cli.authHint: Requires the Devin CLI binary. Run `devin auth login` to authenticate, or provide your WINDSURF_API_KEY. Install: https://cli.devin.ai

codebuddy-cn.name: CodeBuddy CN
codebuddy-cn.authHint: Tencent CodeBuddy CN (copilot.tencent.com). Sign in via the official CLI device-code flow, or paste a direct API key (sent as Authorization: Bearer). Catalog: GLM / Kimi / MiniMax / DeepSeek / Hunyuan.

jules.name: Google Jules
jules.authHint: Jules API key for creating and managing cloud coding tasks.

devin.name: Devin
devin.authHint: Devin API key for cloud agent sessions.

codex-cloud.name: Codex Cloud
codex-cloud.authHint: OpenAI API key with Codex Cloud task access.

brave-search.name: Brave Search
brave-search.authHint: Subscription token from Brave Search API dashboard

firecrawl.name: Firecrawl
firecrawl.authHint: API key from firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys (or set your self-hosted Firecrawl base URL)

google-pse-search.name: Google Programmable Search
google-pse-search.authHint: Requires a Google API key and your Programmable Search Engine ID (cx)

linkup-search.name: Linkup Search
linkup-search.authHint: Bearer API key from the Linkup dashboard

searchapi-search.name: SearchAPI
searchapi-search.authHint: API key from SearchAPI (query param or Bearer auth)

youcom-search.name: You.com Search
youcom-search.authHint: X-API-Key from the You.com platform dashboard

searxng-search.name: SearXNG Search
searxng-search.authHint: API key is optional. Set your SearXNG base URL. Some instances may require a bearer token for access.

x-search.name: X Search (Grok)
x-search.authHint: SuperGrok OAuth (xai-oauth) or xAI API key. This is Grok X Search, not the X Developer MCP.

ollama-search.name: Ollama Search
ollama-search.authHint: Same API key as Ollama Cloud (from ollama.com/settings/keys)

context7.name: Context7 (library docs)
context7.authHint: API key optional (ctx7sk-...) — anonymous tier works without a key; a key raises the rate limit

aws-polly.name: AWS Polly
aws-polly.authHint: Use AWS Secret Access Key as API key; set providerSpecificData.accessKeyId and optional region.

devin-cli-agentic.name: Devin CLI Agentic Bridge
devin-cli-agentic.authHint: Authentication is owned by the official Devin CLI in its isolated bridge volume.

opencode.name: OpenCode Free
opencode.authHint: No API key required — uses OpenCode

duckduckgo-web.name: DuckDuckGo AI Chat
duckduckgo-web.authHint: No credentials required — DuckDuckGo AI Chat is anonymous and free.

cloudflare-playground.name: Cloudflare AI Playground
cloudflare-playground.authHint: No credentials required — anonymous browser sessions over a reverse-engineered cf_agent WebSocket protocol (Playwright transport).

felo-web.name: Felo
felo-web.authHint: No credentials required — Felo is a free, no-signup chat/search aggregator.

theoldllm.name: The Old LLM (Free)
theoldllm.authHint: No credentials required. The executor auto-generates access tokens via an embedded Playwright browser instance.

veoaifree-web.name: Veo AI Free
veoaifree-web.authHint: No auth required. Rate limited to 6 requests/hour per IP.

auggie.name: Augment (Auggie CLI)
auggie.authHint: No API key stored by OmniRoute. Install the Auggie CLI and run `auggie login` on this machine, then OmniRoute spawns it locally for each request.

zcode.name: ZCode (GLM Coding Plan)
zcode.authHint: No API key stored by OmniRoute. The local ZCode app-server uses the existing builtin:zai-coding-plan login.

uncloseai.name: UncloseAI
uncloseai.authHint: No auth required. API accepts any non-empty string as key for identification. If older built-in models return 404, use Available Models → Import from /models or Auto-Sync; verified live model: solidrust/Hermes-3-Llama-3.1-8B-AWQ.

aihorde.name: AI Horde
aihorde.authHint: No API key required — uses AI Horde

mlx-gemma.name: MLX Gemma 26B
mlx-gemma.authHint: No API key required. Runs mlx-lm server locally on port 11435. Requires uv and mlx-lm installed. Model: mlx-community/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-q4_0-mlx-aligned (~15.9GB peak memory).

mlx-qwen.name: MLX Qwen 3.8 27B
mlx-qwen.authHint: No API key required. Runs mlx-lm server locally on port 11436. Requires uv and mlx-lm installed. Model: maglun/Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-Mixed-3.80bpw (~13.1GB peak memory).

ollama-local.name: Ollama
ollama-local.authHint: No API key required. Ollama runs locally — configure its OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://localhost:11434/v1) and make sure Ollama is running before connecting.

lm-studio.name: LM Studio
lm-studio.authHint: API key optional. Configure the local LM Studio OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://localhost:1234/v1).

vllm.name: vLLM
vllm.authHint: API key optional. Configure the local vLLM OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://localhost:8000/v1).

lemonade.name: Lemonade Server

llamafile.name: Llamafile
llamafile.authHint: API key optional. Configure the local Llamafile OpenAI-compatible base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1).

sdwebui.name: SD WebUI
sdwebui.authHint: No API key required. Configure the local WebUI base URL (default: http://localhost:7860).

comfyui.name: ComfyUI
comfyui.authHint: No API key required. Configure the local ComfyUI base URL (default: http://localhost:8188).

conol-web.authHint: Use browser sign-in, or paste the full Cookie header from conol.ai. The __Secure-better-auth.session_token cookie is required.

sarvam.name: Sarvam AI

plamo.name: PLaMo

typhoon.name: Typhoon
typhoon.authHint: Typhoon is OpenAI-compatible on /v1. Built by SCB 10X (Thailand); typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct is a thai-first, multilingual model.

cheaperinference.name: Cheaper Inference

freebuff.name: Freebuff

bazaarlink.authHint: Use your BazaarLink API key (starts with sk-bl-) in Authorization: Bearer <key>. OpenAI SDK works with base URL https://bazaarlink.ai/api/v1. Models use provider/model-name format.

freetheai.authHint: Join the FreeTheAi Discord to get your free API key.

g4f-groq.name: g4f.space — Groq
g4f-groq.authHint: Anonymous use now needs proof-of-work credits baked at g4f.dev/chat — sign up at g4f.dev/members.html for a member key.

g4f-gemini.name: g4f.space — Gemini
g4f-gemini.authHint: Anonymous use now needs proof-of-work credits baked at g4f.dev/chat — sign up at g4f.dev/members.html for a member key.

g4f-pollinations.name: g4f.space — Pollinations
g4f-pollinations.authHint: Anonymous use now needs proof-of-work credits baked at g4f.dev/chat — sign up at g4f.dev/members.html for a member key.

g4f-ollama.name: g4f.space — Ollama
g4f-ollama.authHint: Anonymous use now needs proof-of-work credits baked at g4f.dev/chat — sign up at g4f.dev/members.html for a member key.

g4f-nvidia.name: g4f.space — NVIDIA
g4f-nvidia.authHint: Anonymous use now needs proof-of-work credits baked at g4f.dev/chat — sign up at g4f.dev/members.html for a member key.

gitlawb.name: Gitlawb Opengateway (MiMo)
gitlawb.authHint: Get your API key from Gitlawb Opengateway dashboard.

gitlawb-gmi.name: Gitlawb Opengateway (GMI Cloud)
gitlawb-gmi.authHint: Get your API key from Gitlawb Opengateway dashboard.

thebai.name: TheB.AI
thebai.authHint: Bearer API key for the TheB.AI OpenAI-compatible gateway.

bai.name: b.ai
bai.authHint: Bearer API key for the b.ai OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway (distinct from TheB.AI).

fenayai.name: FenayAI
fenayai.authHint: Bearer API key for the FenayAI OpenAI-compatible gateway.

empower.name: Empower
empower.authHint: Bearer API key for the Empower OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

poe.name: Poe
poe.authHint: Bearer API key for the Poe OpenAI-compatible API.

chutes.name: Chutes.ai
chutes.authHint: Bearer API key for the Chutes OpenAI-compatible gateway.

factory.name: Factory
factory.authHint: Bearer API key for the Factory OpenAI-compatible gateway.

bluesminds.name: BluesMinds
bluesminds.authHint: Get your API key at https://www.bluesminds.com — OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.bluesminds.com/v1 with free daily credits. VIP models (Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro) consume pi credits.

freemodel-dev.name: FreeModel.dev
freemodel-dev.authHint: Get $300 free API credits at https://freemodel.dev — no payment info required. OpenAI-compatible endpoint. GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5 models available.

freeaiapikey.name: FreeAIAPIKey
freeaiapikey.authHint: Discounted API proxy for 40+ models including GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Qwen 3.5. Get your API key at https://freeaiapikey.com/dashboard. Base URL: https://freeaiapikey.com/v1.

zenmux.name: ZenMux
zenmux.authHint: Use your ZenMux API key in Authorization: Bearer <key>. ZenMux is fully OpenAI-compatible. Base URL: https://zenmux.ai/api/v1.

openadapter.name: OpenAdapter
openadapter.authHint: Use your OpenAdapter API key in Authorization: Bearer sk-cv-<key>. Fully OpenAI-compatible. API base URL: https://api.openadapter.in/v1.

dit.name: DIT.ai
dit.authHint: Use your dit.ai API key in Authorization: Bearer <key>. Fully OpenAI-compatible — a drop-in replacement, just change the base URL to https://api.dit.ai/v1.

tokenrouter.name: TokenRouter
tokenrouter.authHint: Use your TokenRouter API key in Authorization: Bearer <key>. Fully OpenAI-compatible. API base URL: https://api.tokenrouter.com/v1.

token-kiosk.name: Token Kiosk
token-kiosk.authHint: Use your Token Kiosk API key in Authorization: Bearer <key>. Fully OpenAI-compatible gateway. API base URL: https://agent-router.gaib.ai/v1.

sumopod.name: SumoPod
sumopod.authHint: Use your SumoPod API key (sk-...) in Authorization: Bearer <key>. Fully OpenAI-compatible. API base URL: https://ai.sumopod.com/v1.

x5lab.name: X5Lab
x5lab.authHint: Use your X5Lab API key (x5-...) in Authorization: Bearer <key>. Fully OpenAI-compatible. API base URL: https://api.x5lab.dev/v1.

chenzk.name: Chenzk API
chenzk.authHint: Create an API key at https://chenzk.top/token, then paste it here as a Bearer token.

kenari.name: Kenari
kenari.authHint: Use your Kenari API key (kn-...) in Authorization: Bearer <key>. Fully OpenAI-compatible. API base URL: https://kenari.id/v1.

navy.name: NavyAI
navy.authHint: Create a free API key from the NavyAI dashboard, then paste it here as a Bearer token.

ainative.name: AINative Studio
ainative.authHint: Create a free API key at ainative.studio (no card), then paste it here as a Bearer token.

aion.name: Aion Labs
aion.authHint: Create a free API key at aionlabs.ai (no card), then paste it here as a Bearer token.

routeway.name: Routeway
routeway.authHint: Create a free API key at routeway.ai, then paste it here as a Bearer token.

nara.name: NaraRouter
nara.authHint: Get a free API key via NaraRouter

regolo.name: Regolo AI
regolo.authHint: Get your Regolo API key from regolo.ai, then paste it here as a Bearer token.

naga-ac.name: Naga.ac
naga-ac.authHint: Get API key at naga.ac — Google/GitHub/Discord signup available.

void-ai.name: Void AI
void-ai.authHint: Use https://api.voidai.app/v1 only after confirming authentication, account eligibility and terms. Treat this integration as experimental until the blocked documentation becomes public.

helixmind.name: HelixMind
helixmind.authHint: Create a helix- key and use https://helixmind.online/v1. OpenAI requests use Bearer authentication; the Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint accepts x-api-key.

logfare.name: Logfare
logfare.authHint: Create a free account at https://logfare.ai/register (username/password, no email verification) to get an instant API key, then paste it here as a Bearer token.

tabitoken.name: TabiToken
tabitoken.authHint: Create an sk- key at https://tabitoken.com and use https://tabitoken.com. The Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint (default) takes x-api-key; /v1/chat/completions takes Bearer.

azure-openai.name: Azure OpenAI
azure-openai.authHint: Use your Azure OpenAI API key. Base URL should be your resource endpoint, for example https://my-resource.openai.azure.com.

azure-ai.name: Azure AI Foundry
azure-ai.authHint: Use your Azure AI Foundry key. Base URL can be https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com/openai/v1/ or https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/.

bedrock.name: Amazon Bedrock
bedrock.authHint: Use your Amazon Bedrock API key and configure the AWS region where your models are enabled (for example eu-west-2). OmniRoute calls Bedrock

watsonx.name: IBM watsonx.ai Gateway
watsonx.authHint: Use your watsonx bearer token. Base URL can be https://<region>.ml.cloud.ibm.com/ml/gateway/v1/ or a self-managed /ml/gateway/v1 endpoint.

oci.name: OCI Generative AI
oci.authHint: Use your OCI Generative AI API key or IAM bearer token. Base URL can be https://inference.generativeai.<region>.oci.oraclecloud.com/openai/v1/.

sap.name: SAP Generative AI Hub
sap.authHint: Use your SAP AI Core bearer token. Base URL can be your AI_API_URL root or a deploymentUrl from Generative AI Hub.

modal.name: Modal
modal.authHint: Use the bearer token that protects your Modal deployment, if enabled. Base URL should point to your OpenAI-compatible Modal app, for example https://<workspace>--<app>.modal.run/v1.

vertex.name: Vertex AI
vertex.authHint: Provide Service Account JSON or OAuth access_token

vertex-partner.name: Vertex AI Partners
vertex-partner.authHint: Provide the same Service Account JSON used for Vertex AI partner models.

cloudflare-ai.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
cloudflare-ai.authHint: Requires API Token AND Account ID (found at dash.cloudflare.com)

datarobot.name: DataRobot
datarobot.authHint: Use your DataRobot API token. Optional Base URL can be the account root (for LLM Gateway) or a deployment URL under /api/v2/deployments/<id>.

clarifai.name: Clarifai
clarifai.authHint: Use your Clarifai PAT or app-specific API key. OmniRoute targets the OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.clarifai.com/v2/ext/openai/v1 and authenticates with Authorization: Key <token>.

nlpcloud.name: NLP Cloud
nlpcloud.authHint: Use your NLP Cloud API key in Authorization: Token <key>. OmniRoute targets the chatbot endpoint on https://api.nlpcloud.io/v1/gpu/<model>/chatbot by default.

runwayml.name: Runway
runwayml.authHint: Use your Runway API key in Authorization: Bearer <key>. OmniRoute targets the current Runway API at https://api.dev.runwayml.com/v1 and sends the required X-Runway-Version header automatically.

pollinations.name: Pollinations AI
pollinations.authHint: Anonymous/keyless access to the documented free models is best-effort. Local v3.8.50 verification (2026-07-31) returned 401 via OmniRoute and Cloudflare 1010 on direct upstream probes from the same network. Premium models still require a Pollinations API key from enter.pollinations.ai.

magnific.name: Magnific
magnific.authHint: Get an API key at magnific.com/user/api-keys (header x-magnific-api-key). Legacy Freepik developer keys still work.

suno.name: Suno
suno.authHint: Paste session cookie from suno.ai (Clerk auth)

udio.name: Udio
udio.authHint: Paste session cookie from udio.com (Supabase auth)

gitlab.name: GitLab Duo PAT
gitlab.authHint: GitLab personal access token for the public Code Suggestions API. Configure a self-hosted base URL when not using gitlab.com.

voyage-ai.name: Voyage AI
voyage-ai.authHint: Bearer API key for Voyage AI embeddings and rerank APIs.

jina-ai.name: Jina AI (Foundation API)
jina-ai.authHint: Bearer API key for api.jina.ai — embeddings, rerank, classify, segment, and search. Dashboard keys take precedence over JINA_AI_API_KEY. This is not the Reader / r.jina.ai card and does not fetch URLs.

segmind.name: Segmind
segmind.authHint: Use your Segmind API key in the x-api-key header. OmniRoute targets https://api.segmind.com/v1/<model> and returns the generated image/video bytes directly.

dify.name: Dify
dify.authHint: Get API key from your Dify instance.

mixedbread.name: Mixedbread AI
mixedbread.authHint: Bearer API key for the Mixedbread embeddings API.

jina-reader.name: Jina Reader (r.jina.ai)
jina-reader.authHint: Bearer API key for r.jina.ai URL-to-markdown (/v1/web/fetch only). Does not serve /v1/embeddings or /v1/rerank. The same Jina token as Foundation API works; OmniRoute reuses a jina-ai dashboard key or JINA_AI_API_KEY when this card is empty.

deepai.name: DeepAI
deepai.authHint: Use your DeepAI API key. Get one at deepai.org — requires a Pro subscription ($9.99/mo).

cursor-api.name: Cursor API
cursor-api.authHint: Paste a Cursor user API key (crsr_...) from cursor.com/dashboard/api. OmniRoute exchanges it for a session token on demand; no IDE or cursor-agent install is needed. Usage bills to the Cursor plan that owns the key.
